Jaipur Haveli Treasure: 66.4 kg Silver Recovered, 5 Arrested

Jaipur police have solved the case of a treasure found during the demolition of a haveli in Manak Chowk. Ten months after the discovery, five individuals have been arrested. The police recovered 66.4 kilograms of silver. Reports indicate the treasure was found during renovation work on a 100-year-old haveli. The contractor allegedly did not inform the owner and instead shared the silver with laborers, leading to changes in their lifestyles.
